meta.title: DSE English Paper Drills Batch 1
meta.subject: DSE english
meta.reviewStrategy: Gate1 does not mark the aggregate English learn bank reviewed:true. (1) Published SAMPLE in english-drills.json stays reviewed:true. File order maps SAMPLE-01 through SAMPLE-19; disposition is on that file's meta.sampleDisposition. (2) These 32 Batch EN-1 items are curriculum-locked and each has batchReviewed:true. They are self-authored and are not HKEAA text. (3) The pre-existing learn-mode bank in english-learn-drills.json stays reviewed:false. Sampling rule for a later pass, not a flag flip: an item is in the sample when the trailing integer of its id modulo 5 is 0 or 1 (two residue classes out of five, 40%), or when explanation.trim().length < 40.
meta.note: Self-authored Paper 1–4 drills (12/8/6/6). Not HKEAA past-paper text. Merged into the English drill bank beside the 19-item SAMPLE. Aggregate learn bank stays reviewed:false; see reviewStrategy.

questions.question: A short notice says: "Lab closed 3–5 p.m. for safety drill." What should a student do?
options: A. Avoid the lab during 3–5 p.m.
questions.explanation: The notice blocks 3–5 p.m.（提示：Check the time window.）
questions.subject: english

questions.question: In a leaflet, the heading is usually meant to…
options: A. Tell the main topic quickly
questions.explanation: Headings flag the topic.（提示：Headings guide readers.）
questions.subject: english

questions.question: "Please RSVP by Friday" most nearly means…
options: A. Reply whether you will attend by Friday
B. Pay a fee every Friday
C. Rewrite the essay by Friday
questions.explanation: Confirm attendance by Friday.（提示：RSVP = reply.）
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which question checks vocabulary-in-context?
options: A. What does "drain" mean in this sentence?
B. Who is the author of HKEAA papers?
C. How many ads are on the page?
questions.explanation: Asks word meaning in the sentence.（提示：Meaning in context.）
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage (self-written, 42 words): "Maya checked her notes twice before the group call. She wanted every figure to match the spreadsheet." What can we infer?
questions.explanation: Careful checking → accuracy.（提示：Clues: checked twice; match.）
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Passage (98 words, self-written): "When the museum delayed the exhibit, volunteers rewrote floor maps, emailed schools, and posted a calm FAQ. Visitors still came—just with clearer expectations." Which statement is best supported?
options: A. Clear communication reduced confusion after the delay
B. The museum cancelled all education programmes
questions.explanation: Communication → clearer expectations.（提示：Maps + FAQ + clearer expectations.）
questions.subject: english

questions.question: In that passage, "calm FAQ" most nearly suggests the team wanted to…
options: A. Reduce panic by answering likely questions steadily
C. Replace the exhibit with ads
questions.explanation: Calm + FAQ = steady answers.（提示：Tone of FAQ.）
questions.subject: english

questions.question: Which inference is NOT justified by the passage?
options: A. Every visitor preferred the delay to the original plan
B. Schools were informed by email
questions.explanation: "Every visitor preferred…" is not supported.（提示：Find the leap.）
questions.subject: english

questions.question: A question asks for the writer's attitude toward the volunteers. Best evidence-based answer?
